label: Sale or discount
summary: Transparent promotional pricing and discount terms
Clear expiration dates and applicable conditions
Truthful savings comparisons against standard pricing
tone_principles: Exciting, transparent, and fair. Avoid deceptive fine print.
writing_style: Concise promotional copy emphasizing actual savings and qualification criteria.
messaging_principles: Discounts must specify eligible categories, promo codes, and campaign duration.

rules.title: Substantiate Promotional Discounts & Exclusions
rules.description: Sale copy must clarify promo terms rather than claiming unconstrained giveaways.

suggested_replacements.insane prices that will bankrupt us: our biggest promotional discount of the season

rules.do_example: Save 20% on selected seasonal items through Sunday evening.
rules.dont_example: We are giving everything away for free at insane prices that will bankrupt us!

terminology.notes: State promotional discounts with professional clarity.
